snippet.title: Dead in Antares - Commented Combat Trailer
snippet.description:
Benjamin, producer on Dead in Antares, presents for the very first time the combat of the game, highlighting the newest features, such as the Power Surge!

A free demo will be available on August 27th on Steam!

About Dead in Antares:
Dead in Antares is a turn-based survival management game with RPG elements, set on an alien planet. Lead a crew of survivors sent on a mission to save humanity. Manage their needs, strengthen their teamwork, and explore this mysterious world to find a way back home. 

Add Dead in Antares to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2511800/Dead_in_Antares/
